shortlist.instruction: Love your neighbor as yourself.
Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
Children, obey your parents in the Lord
shortlist.reason: this is right

shortlist.instruction: let us love one another
shortlist.reason: love comes from God

shortlist.instruction: Come, follow Me,
shortlist.reason: I will make you fishers of men

shortlist.instruction: Do not judge, or you will be judged.
do not worry about your life
Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them!
shortlist.reason: For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

shortlist.instruction: Do not let your hearts be troubled.
Be kind and tenderhearted to one another
shortlist.reason: in Christ God forgave you

shortlist.instruction: Put on the full armor of God
shortlist.reason: so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes

shortlist.instruction: Rejoice in the Lord always.
Be anxious for nothing
Do not be conformed to this world
Do not repay anyone evil for evil.
serve one another in love.
shortlist.reason: you, brothers, were called to freedom

shortlist.instruction: Carry one another’s burdens
shortlist.reason: in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ

shortlist.instruction: Do not let the sun set upon your anger
be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
Do not lie to one another
shortlist.reason: you have taken off the old self with its practices

shortlist.instruction: clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
shortlist.reason: as the elect of God, holy and beloved

shortlist.instruction: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else.
Devote yourselves to prayer
Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence
shortlist.reason: so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need

shortlist.instruction: let us run with endurance the race set out for us
shortlist.reason: we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses

shortlist.instruction: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus
Be doers of the word, and not hearers only.
shortlist.reason: Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves

shortlist.instruction: Draw near to God
shortlist.reason: He will draw near to you

shortlist.instruction: be holy in all you do
shortlist.reason: just as He who called you is holy

shortlist.instruction: Treat everyone with high regard
let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth
Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.
shortlist.reason: for the kingdom of heaven is near

shortlist.instruction: Repent and believe in the gospel!
shortlist.reason: The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is near.

shortlist.instruction: Guard yourselves against every form of greed
shortlist.reason: for one’s life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions

shortlist.instruction: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought
Be devoted to one another in brotherly love.
Bless those who persecute you.
Do not avenge yourselves
shortlist.reason: Vengeance belongs to God; the Lord says he will repay

shortlist.instruction: If your enemy is hungry, feed him
shortlist.reason: you will heap burning coals on his head

shortlist.instruction: walk by the Spirit
shortlist.reason: you will not gratify the desires of the flesh

shortlist.instruction: Let us not grow weary in well-doing
shortlist.reason: in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up

shortlist.instruction: let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
Be imitators of God
shortlist.reason: as beloved children

shortlist.instruction: Walk as children of light
shortlist.reason: you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord

shortlist.instruction: take up the shield of faith
shortlist.reason: with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one

shortlist.instruction: Pray in the Spirit at all times
Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
Keep yourself pure.
flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness
Fight the good fight of the faith.
Make every effort to present yourself approved to God

cut.instruction: love one another deeply, from a pure heart
Let the little children come to Me

Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult

cut.why: said to the rich young man only

cut.instruction: Do not be afraid; just believe
let us stop judging one another.

cut.why: a repeat of Rejoice in the Lord always
